source_note: The saved EIG/Savills appearance describes a freehold detached former school at Seven Springs, Cheltenham, extending to 13,000 square feet on 5.32 acres with residential conversion consent. Historic England identifies the Grade II Sandford School at Coberley, Seven Springs and records that it was formerly Seven Springs House. A Department for Education-derived establishment record and archived planning records give Sandford School's complete postal address as Seven Springs, Cheltenham, Gloucestershire, GL53 9NG. A contractor's project history independently describes the Seven Springs building as a Grade II former school restored after falling into disrepair. These independent features conservatively identify the auction appearance without relying on locality alone.
